quoted_or_paraphrased_content: Official vendor confirmed as Taiwan Economic Journal (台灣經濟新報 / 台灣經濟新報文化事業股份有限公司). Page states company leverages "30多年來的財金資料庫收錄整理經驗" (30+ years of financial database compilation experience). Product families named: ESG/TESG, TCRI credit risk, KYC/SME due diligence, TQuant Lab, valuation analytics, BIS/Censrisk regtech, Taiwan/China/Hong Kong securities and macroeconomic databases.

Page was fully reachable with no login/payment/download wall encountered at this URL. No explicit licensing/access-terms document or historical-vintage/revision policy is published on the accessible content. The page references a customer login portal ("提供服務客戶登入專區"), a paid learning academy ("TEJ金融知識學院-付費學習"), and an E-SHOP transaction page, but does not itself gate any of this specific page's own content behind login -- it simply does not contain licensing/access-terms text. No public price list or terms document was located on any page reached this round without navigating into the login-gated portal, which Phase B did not attempt to enter (SS11.1).

上市(櫃)調整股價(日)-均價 (Adjusted Daily Stock Price - Average); 上市(櫃)未調整股價(日) (Unadjusted Daily Stock Price); 上市(櫃)股價報酬(日)-報酬率 (Daily Stock Return Rate); 上市(櫃)調整股價(日)技術指標 (Daily Technical Indicators) -- all listed as named products on TEJ's own Taiwan-market database-solution page.
三大法人買賣超 (Three Major Institutional Investors Buy-Sell Excess), including 外資法人持股 (foreign institutional holdings) and domestic investor trading, listed as a named product.

Same product family as institutional_flow (三大法人買賣超) -- the public page does not distinguish a separately-named "gross" (total buy/sell before netting) variant from the net buy-sell-excess product; family-level match only, not an exact per-field product name.
集保股權分散 (Depository Shareholding Concentration), also listed as "集保庫存分散"; 籌碼分佈 (chip distribution, price-level shareholding, noted 2008 onward) listed as a related but distinct product.
產業分類屬性 (Industry Classification Attributes) -- sector and subsector coding, listed as a named product under Company Information.
上市(櫃)月營收盈餘 (Monthly Revenue and Earnings) -- listed as a named product under Financial Statement Data.
IFRS以合併為主簡表(累計)-全產業 (IFRS Consolidated Abbreviated Statement, cumulative, all industries) -- listed as a named product under Financial Statement Data.

Page was fully reachable with no login/payment/download wall encountered. No distinct, separately-named product for a per-row revenue-YoY-growth dataset appears anywhere on this accessible page. This is recorded as an evidentiary gap distinct from the licensing_terms gap (row 2) that applies to all 8 datasets -- for revenue_growth specifically, even the official product name itself was not located on any publicly reachable page this round.

This establishes an independent public TDCC channel exists for shareholding-concentration data in principle, but does NOT confirm the actual tej_cache/tdcc_weekly corpus's provenance (imported via tej_importer.py, i.e. through TEJ as vendor) -- recorded as supplementary context only, not used to score Gate R4-A for this dataset, and not a Track B remediation-channel finding (Track B is NOT_EVALUATED this phase).
